title: PeerReview
description: Output of Phase 4. The dispatched panel roles review the diff (all six at architectural/trivial tier; ba+dev+qa+secops plus surface-conditional dba/devops at standard tier, per status.json panel_roles). Orchestrator merges the per-role shards and computes final_verdict. Only dispatched roles appear as keys; an absent role key means trimmed-by-tier, never a missing review. APPROVE_WITH_NOTES is canonical; APPROVE_WITH_NITS is a legacy alias kept valid for archived runs.

blockers.description: Collected from all REQUEST_CHANGES blocks. Must be cleared before merge.

verdict.description: REQUEST_REFACTOR is QA-only (testability). VETO is SecOps-only.

severity.description: This schema is the single source of truth for concern severity. The canonical panel vocabulary is blocker|major|nit (DBA/DevOps/Design emit these); SecOps's CVE-style critical|high|medium|low|info is accepted alongside it so a SecOps concern (e.g. severity 'low') validates cleanly. Distinct from the knowledge_drift_claims severity field.

must_satisfy.description: What a correct fix must BE TRUE OF, carrying in itself the observation whose outcome decides whether it is met - never HOW to make it true. A mechanism you weighed goes in rationale_not_checked. TYPED HERE AND UNENFORCED HERE, deliberately: this subschema has NO required list, and must_satisfy is not being added to one, because adding one turns the shipped self-test in scripts/validate-pipeline-artifact.mjs from 68 passed / 0 failed to 65 passed / 3 failed. The three cases that would redden are 'panel major severity accepted', 'panel concern severity low accepted (CVE-style)' and 'panel concern severity critical accepted (CVE-style)'; they live in validate-pipeline-artifact.mjs, which this change may not edit. Tracked in #38. So a Phase 4 reviewer who writes a mechanism here gets no pushback from any machine today. (a) WHERE A MISSING PROPERTY IS REFUSED, all three locations, none of them this file: Phase 2 concerns[] in review.schema.json, and remediation on SecOps vulnerabilities[]. NOT on SecOps compliance_flags[], whose items subschema has no required list at all - a VETO with no statute, no concern and no action validates SILENT. NOT on any Phase 4 peer-review artifact, which is this one (#38). (b) THE ENFORCEMENT RECORD IS DATED AND SCOPED BY DEPLOYMENT MODE, never by repository identity. WINDOW: measured 2026-08-21. POPULATION: one machine's ~/.claude/projects transcript corpus, 1638 files / 353,907 lines across 8 repositories. FINDING: 56 genuine blocks, every one of them in a project that dispatches BARE agent names from local .claude/agents/*.md files; ZERO across roughly 635 plugin-namespaced dispatches in six repositories, one of them an adopting project with 365 of them. RE-DERIVATION: count messages whose message.content is a plain string beginning 'Stop hook feedback:\nPipeline artifact failed schema validation', group by project directory, cross-tabulate against recorded Task subagent_type values; and run the four-cell agent_type fixture ('secops', 'SecOps', 'pipeline:secops', 'agent-pipeline:secops') against the shipped hook. The installed plugin with namespaced names is the shipping default, so read this as a dated record and not as a warranty for your deployment. Filed as #66; the correct outcome for #66 is that somebody fixes it, on which day this paragraph becomes false and a silence has no event that notices. (c) THE FAIL-OPEN DEGRADATIONS, five of them: the enforced half degrades to nothing when node is absent, when the plugin root is unset, when the active issue is unresolvable, when the artifact's mtime exceeds 30 minutes, and - dominantly, and this is the one that screens off the other four - when the stopping agent's type does not match an AGENT_RULES key (validate-pipeline-artifact.mjs:93 for the keys, :654-656 for the lookup and its early return). (d) THE EMPTY STRING SATISFIES, wherever the field IS required: the walker implements no minLength and the requirement cannot be conditioned on severity. Measured 2026-08-21 over the bare-name deployments where the gate fires, which is a DIFFERENT and much larger population than the knowledge/issue-archive/ folder beside this schema: 17 of 229 already-written vulnerability rows there carry no remediation - info 9, low 4, medium 4, and ZERO of the 3 critical and ZERO of the 26 high. Counting the local archive will not reproduce that denominator and is not meant to. (e) THE ARCHIVE RESIDUAL. What you write here is copied verbatim into knowledge/issue-archive/<n>.json, which IS committed, and that copy runs through the absolute-path redactor in knowledge-store.mjs. A property that OPENS with a route is rewritten: origin/main today carries LEADING_SPAN (knowledge-store.mjs:147), which replaces the leading path span only and leaves the prose after it standing; the earlier ABSOLUTE_VALUE form replaced the WHOLE value, prose and all. The invariant true under BOTH forms, and the only one to rely on, is that a LEADING path span does not survive into the durable record - so put the route mid-sentence or the archived property loses its subject. Check which form is live rather than trusting this sentence: grep -n 'ABSOLUTE_VALUE\|LEADING_SPAN' plugins/pipeline/scripts/knowledge-store.mjs. Because that copy is verbatim and public, never paste credential material into this field - and read that as a rule you honor, not a control that protects you: there is no length check, no pattern check and no redaction of credential material on this path, so a pasted secret validates clean and is archived as written. (f) THE NEIGHBOUR LIMIT. This annotation warrants nothing beyond its own field. It warrants NOTHING about the concern severity enum beside it: 10 already-archived panel rows carry values outside that enum, and nothing here changes whether they validate. It warrants NOTHING about this file's root required list, which is [final_verdict, reviewed_at] - verified at the merge base - because no AGENT_RULES entry targets the document root, so that list has no validation path at all.

rationale_not_checked.description: OPTIONAL, and never in any required list. The non-binding landing spot for a candidate mechanism you weighed in order to test a property's COST or falsify its necessity. No downstream role owes this field an action, and a fix that ignores it is not thereby wrong.

notes.description: Free-text reasoning. String preferred; an array of strings is accepted (agents emit both in practice).

knowledge_drift_claims.description: Optional staleness claims for the Librarian, recorded INSIDE the block (never as a sibling key beside it).
